```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
raw_data = read.csv("sensitivity_opt.csv")

colnames(raw_data)[1] = "Slide"

CONCS = c(rep(10, 3), rep(1, 3), rep(0.5, 3), rep(0.25, 3), rep(0.1, 3), rep(0.05, 3), rep(0.01, 3), rep(0, 3))

cabs = c("cAb7", "cAb8", "cAb9", "cAb10", "cAb14", "cAb15", "cAb20", "cAb21", "cAb25", "cAb26")

replicate_num = rep(c(1,2,3), 8)
```

```{r}
processed_data = raw_data %>% 
  select(c('Slide', 'Block', 'Row', 'F635.Mean', 'B635.Mean')) %>% 
  mutate(BackSubtractMean = F635.Mean - B635.Mean) %>% 
  mutate(BackSubtractMean =  case_when(
    BackSubtractMean < 1 ~ 1,
    .default = BackSubtractMean
  )) %>% 
  select(-c(F635.Mean, B635.Mean)) %>% 
  group_by(Slide, Block, Row)
  
summary_rows = processed_data %>% 
  # Remove outliers
  summarise(avg_fluorescence = mean(BackSubtractMean),
            std_fluorescence = sd(BackSubtractMean),
            )

# change the value of tukey fence to modify the stringency of outlier grouping
tukey_fence = 3
joined_data = left_join(processed_data, summary_rows, by = c("Slide", "Block", "Row"))
joined_data = joined_data %>% mutate(SD_fence = std_fluorescence * tukey_fence,
                       checked_val = 
                         ifelse(BackSubtractMean < avg_fluorescence - SD_fence | 
                                  BackSubtractMean > avg_fluorescence + SD_fence, 
                         avg_fluorescence, 
                         BackSubtractMean))

# This tells you the value of the observation that's been changed
setdiff(processed_data$BackSubtractMean, joined_data$checked_val)

processed_data$BackSubtractMean = joined_data$checked_val

# Recompute means
processed_data = processed_data %>% 
  summarise(avg_fluorescence = mean(BackSubtractMean))
processed_data$replicate = replicate_num[processed_data$Block]
processed_data$Block = CONCS[processed_data$Block]
processed_data$Row = cabs[processed_data$Row]

processed_data
processed_data = processed_data %>% 
  rename(c(Conc. = "Block", cAb = "Row", label = "Slide")) %>% 
  ungroup()

unique(processed_data$avg_fluorescence)
length(unique(processed_data$avg_fluorescence))

processed_data$target_vector = gsub("_(.*)", "", processed_data$label, perl=T)
processed_data
cleaned_data = processed_data %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "cAb",
                                              values_from = 'avg_fluorescence')
cleaned_data

# write.csv(cleaned_data, file = 'processed_sensitivity_opt_data.csv', row.names = F)
```
